annotations.title: Turn the app's Google sign-in on or off, in Development

description: Turns "Continue with Google" on or off for the app's customers, in Development only — always, whether or not the app is live. It never touches Live's own switch, which keeps running whatever it was set to: ask for that with request_google_signin_switch (a browser click, never a code).
name: set_google_signin
title: Turn the app's Google sign-in on or off, in Development
